baseline: Odoo-inspired Admin Business Operations Portal R2.1
objective: Provide a professional 360-degree operating portal that connects audience, catalog, content, trust, commercial, finance and system control without losing record-level accountability.

design_inspiration.source: Odoo 19 information architecture and interaction patterns
adapted_patterns: full workspace application launcher and horizontal module workspaces
search, filter, group by and favorites
mauve top application bar and module-level menu anatomy

professional_criteria: status never relies on color alone
numbers show period and evidence boundary

modules.business_question: Is the entire platform healthy and what needs attention now?
What work should each operator do next?
Is this Place complete, current, trusted and effective?
What policy decision should be made and can it be audited?
Where is content in the intake-to-publication pipeline?
How does a business move from lead to paid and retained partner?
Is sponsored delivery transparent, effective and paid?
How do people discover, decide and take external action?
What money is verified, what is spent and how long can the project operate?
Who can do what and are systems safe and available?

scope_boundary.design_baseline: All ten modules have a representative final-design surface and navigation path.
scope_boundary.not_production_logic: Metrics and records in the gallery are illustrative data contracts, not a live backend.
scope_boundary.mvp_note: The portal information architecture is complete; implementation may phase modules according to PRO-03 and technical dependency order.
scope_boundary.one_source_rule: Guest and Pilot remain sourced from Prototype R2.3; this baseline only expands Admin.
